Adjacent paragraphs in a layout-table cell are separated rather than concatenated into one run of text

```php title="PHP"
<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

require_once __DIR__ . '/vendor/autoload.php';

use HtmlToMarkdown\HtmlToMarkdown;
use HtmlToMarkdown\ConversionOptions;
$options = \HtmlToMarkdown\ConversionOptions::from_json(json_encode(["compactTables" => true]));
$result = HtmlToMarkdown::convert("<table><tr><td><p><b>Alice Example</b></p><p><i>Customer Service</i></p></td><td>Logo</td></tr><tr><td>A</td><td>B</td><td>C</td></tr></table>", $options);
var_dump($result->content);
```
